cause_quote: The new `options?.automatic` path still returned early when `![initial.descriptor.previous.identity, initial.descriptor.candidate.identity].includes(replacementIdentity)`, so a device renumbering prevented settlement even when repair could verify the installation.
user_saw: After an interrupted package update and a reboot that changed the filesystem device number, subsequent CLI and Control UI updates failed with `update-recovery-pending` until the user ran `openclaw update repair`.
summary: The fix uses verified remount-mapped package identities at the automatic settlement gate so the next update can clear the interrupted publication and proceed.
reasoning: I checked that #169038 introduced the raw identity gate for stale-lease recovery and that #170046 added remount-aware identity checks downstream for explicit repair. When #181307 broadened automatic settlement to untouched preparations and verified installed candidates, it retained that early gate, so those newly supported cases failed after a device renumbering from the outset.
